how: Add a GET /healthz endpoint that returns 200 with a JSON status body, fronted by the existing RateLimiter middleware so health checks can't be used to bypass rate limits.
appliedDirectives: Public routes register in src/routes.ts, not inline in server.ts — per 2026-06-01-routes-register-in-routes-ts

resolvedGaps.question: Should /healthz require auth?
resolvedGaps.answer: No — health checks must stay unauthenticated so orchestrators can probe them.
